args.body:
• Newsletter (Saltmarsh Foods, "Retail returns logistics"): this week's issue is on retail returns logistics, pointing to the article at blog.saltmarsh.example/2026/returns and a companion piece at insights.saltmarsh.example/returns/companion (team-licence access via ?team=&seat=).
• Linked article: apparel return rates have reached 24%, and consolidating return hubs cut handling cost by a fifth.
• Companion piece: reselling returned goods within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
args.title: Saltmarsh Foods newsletter — Retail returns logistics (3-bullet summary)
